description: Create ONE original FRONT hairstyle on this EXACT owned Shaman head. Original warm golden-brown curtain hairstyle shape: precise central root split, two broad curved curtain wings flowing down diagonally, layered feathered cheek-length ends taper just below both ears, a small inverted V forehead opening, symmetrical overall mass with slight natural strand variation. Low rounded crown, medium length and controlled width, coherent large curved locks rather than many thin noisy lines. Tips follow both cheeks and flick gently inward, not a bowl bob, tall spikes or a wolf mullet. Source pale muted lavender-silver for recoloring into warm gold, not pure white. Both original eyes and brows visible; retain original ears/face. Preserve exact skull proportions, face, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, jaw and neck; no new face or body. Coherent root-to-tip pixel clusters, limited purposeful highlights, clean connected masses, no antialiasing or random bright pixels. Finish every tip inside mask with transparent margins. Head only, one front view, no sheet, text or accessories. Keep all unmasked RGBA exact.
